parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SearchName
parameters.description: A string contained in the data source name. The system performs a fuzzy match based on this string to retrieve matching data source names.
